blocks.content: Quiz: Why must component names start with a capital letter?
Tap an option below to answer:
To make the code look more professional
This is a technical requirement, not a style choice.
This is a technical requirement, not a style choice.
JavaScript doesn't care about capitalization for function names.
JavaScript doesn't care about capitalization for function names.
To prevent naming conflicts with CSS classes
CSS classes are unrelated to component names.
CSS classes are unrelated to component names.
So React can distinguish components from regular HTML tags
React will interpret components beginning with lowercase as HTML tags. Think about <div> vs <EntryCard>.
React will interpret components beginning with lowercase as HTML tags. Think about <div> vs <EntryCard>.
